headline: Security forces killed 15 suspected militants in two operations in Balochistan's Mastung district, destroying several hideouts and recovering a large quantity of weapons and ammunition, officials said on Saturday, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Kai thikane tabah, bari miqdar mein aslaha baramad

caption:
Mastung mein do operations, 15 mushtaba militants halak! 🇵🇰
Arab News ke mutabiq officials ne Saturday ko bataya ke Balochistan ke district Mastung mein security forces ki do karwaiyon mein 15 mushtaba militants halak ho gaye. Kai thikane tabah kiye gaye aur bari miqdar mein aslaha aur gola barood baramad hua. Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne security forces ki tareef ki, jabke Wazir-e-Ala Balochistan Sarfraz Bugti ke mutabiq chaar ilaqon ko militants se saaf kar diya gaya hai.
Balochistan mein aman ke liye aap ke khayal mein sab se zaroori qadam kya hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
